name: Aibeya 2
source:
"It's hot..."

Summer is just around the corner. Tokizaki Youichi's air conditioner chose such a timing for it to broke down. It would take quiet a while to repair, so it seems, and as such he's at his wits end. While he is at a loss for what to do, his childhood friend Misora Saku, who is staying in the next room over, makes an unexpected suggestion.

She said, "You know what? Our room has a sliding door, right? If we open that door, it will be cooler, isn't it?"

Now that their rooms are connected, they are now aware of each other presences. What will happen to their relationship...?

[Edited from [url=http://azarashi-soft.nexton-net.jp/aibeya2/story.html]Official Website[/url]]
translation:
“好热……”

盛夏将至，鸨崎阳一房间里的空调偏偏在这个时候坏了。修理似乎也需要不少时间，让他一筹莫展。正当他不知如何是好时，借住在隔壁房间的青梅竹马御空朔，提出了一个意想不到的建议。

“那个，我们的房间之间，不是有扇推拉门吗？把那扇门打开，是不是就能凉快一点了？”

两个房间连在一起，也让两人开始在意起彼此的存在。他们的关系将会如何发展……？

[编译自[url=http://azarashi-soft.nexton-net.jp/aibeya2/story.html]官网[/url]]
